note: A one-time code for the application form, which was filed as a rejection because its subject matches "your application to". Not job-search mail at all. The envelope is modeled on one from the Jev trial (a trial write-up, not kept in the repository because it quoted the person's own data), with the company, names and addresses changed. The body was not fetched: Gmail was not reachable from the session that wrote this (plan #1227), and the ledger never stores one, so the fixture holds only what the rules read from the envelope.
